exceptions.reason: D-03 (Phase 100b): this route resets a single test-only tenant's full dataset for e2e bootstrapping. The 17 deleteMany calls (lines 241-276) are the teardown: giving every context its own destructive resetForTests() on its PERMANENT public surface would be the worse trade in an audit-proof system, so this direct-access path is excepted instead of facaded. The route is gated behind ALLOW_TEST_BOOTSTRAP, never registers on int or prod, and its teardown only ever matches tenant IDs of the form ^test-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{8}$, so the exception exists for something that is not reachable in a real environment at all. The 4 create calls (overtimeAccount:172, leaveType:179, leaveEntitlement:187, terminalApiKey:331) are seeding calls for the same test-only bootstrap route and are excepted on the same grounds; terminalApiKey.create at line 331 is a separate seeding block outside the teardown handler proper but serves the identical test-bootstrap purpose.
